notes: Default managed startup uses the ONNX Parakeet bridge so Windows can run without WSL.
Install onnx-asr and ONNX Runtime in this Python environment first: pip install "onnx-asr[cpu,hub]".
Set PARAKEET_ONNX_MODEL_ID to a local model directory or another onnx-asr model alias when needed.
The legacy NeMo/WSL bridge remains at sidecars/parakeet_bridge/server.py.
